author: Gabriella Baiano
title: Shelter in place order lifted in Fredonia - NewsBreak
text:
By Gabriella Baiano Angelica Gallagher Mark Ludwiczak ,
8 hours ago
BUFFALO, N.Y. (WIVB) — A shelter in place order for White Street in Fredonia has been lifted, police said. The order was initially announced Wednesday around 3 p.m.
Police sources and Fredonia Mayor Michael Ferguson confirmed Wednesday afternoon that a person was barricaded inside of a home on White Street.
“This started early in the morning, since about 8:30 this morning,” Ferguson said Wednesday afternoon. “A person was outside the building and has now barricaded himself in the basement of the building. We have not only Fredonia police here, Dunkirk police have been here for most of the day as well as New York State police.”
Law enforcement was on scene for hours until later Wednesday night, when officers were seen taking someone into custody outside of the home.
Ferguson is not sharing any details of the operation at this point, but did say that the person barricaded in the home has not been in the Fredonia area for very long.
“What I’ve heard or understood, he’s relatively new to the community, within a few weeks, so I have no idea what set this off,” Ferguson said.
This is a developing story that will be updated as more information becomes available.
